state.fact: An edition owner has attached one reserved label to a pending creation operation. The independent label claim has not yet confirmed the attachment. The draft remains in an intermediate activating state; users cannot add entries or publish yet. A later separate fact CriteriaEditionDrafted is raised once claim confirmation is recorded.

old_precise.instructions: Given state.fact, does CriteriaEditionDraftActivated accurately convey the pending state without suggesting the draft is already usable?

old_active.instructions: Given state.fact, could CriteriaEditionDraftActivated imply that activation is fully complete?

attached_precise.instructions: Given state.fact, does CriteriaEditionDraftLabelAttached clearly name the completed intermediate fact without implying the draft is already usable?

started_precise.instructions: Given state.fact, does CriteriaEditionDraftActivationStarted clearly name the completed intermediate fact without implying the draft is already usable?

meaningful_difference.instructions: Given state.fact, is the difference between attaching the reserved label and finishing draft activation important to a caller deciding whether it can edit the draft?
